names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 марта ст. ст., «Николай (Попов), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the forename to «Николая» and gives the name without the surname.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line with for 13 марта ст. ст.: «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1919).»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1919).»

attestations.note: Neither the day page nor name page 14415 carries a life. The name page lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. That page also links a parish church dedicated to him, «Храм Священномученика Николая Верхнегнутовского с. Староселье», in the diocese of Uryupinsk and Novoanninsky, which is where the epithet Верхнегнутовский is read from; the calendar itself does not print that epithet in his name.
